answer:
Your Projects note is now a kanban board app. I opened it on a phone-sized screen and tried quick-add and the "move to" action, and both worked. I did not test drag-and-drop, the card detail editor, the search and filters, or the Mac layout. The checker also flagged low text contrast on about 16 elements, such as the board name and column counts, which I left as they are.

- **Boards and columns:** you can have several boards. Each starts with To do, Doing and Done. Columns can be added, renamed (double-click the name, or use the column's ⋯ menu) and moved left or right. Deleting a column moves its cards into another column.
- **Cards:** type a title in a column's "Add a card…" box and press Enter. Tap a card to edit its description, due date, labels, checklist and column.
- **Moving cards:**
  - **Drag:** on the Mac you can drag a card to another column or to a spot within a column.
  - **Move to:** every card has a "Move to" menu with the other columns, plus Move up and Move down. This is the phone way.
- **Search and filters:** you can search card text, filter by label, and show only overdue cards. Overdue cards show in red with their due date, and cards in the last column never count as overdue.
- **Archive:** a column's menu has "Archive all cards", and a card's details have Archive. The Archive button lists archived cards so you can restore or delete them.
- **Demo data:** there are two boards, "Website relaunch" and "Home & life", each with about seven cards. The due dates are set relative to today, so some are overdue and some are coming up.

Delete asks for no confirmation, because confirmation pop-ups don't show in this app. Undo is available if you delete something by mistake.
